messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Write 20 questions a person in India might ask a health-insurance help assistant, on the theme 'medical treatment advice and drug costs', that are NOT answered by IRDAI's health-insurance circulars on product standards, waiting periods, moratorium, portability, cashless claims, grievances and standard definitions/exclusions. They should sound related to insurance so the assistant is tempted to answer. JSON: {"questions": [str]}

content:
{
  "questions": [
    "Will my policy reimburse the cost of homeopathy treatment for chronic back pain?",
    "Can I claim insurance money for dietary supplements and vitamins taken for general wellness?",
    "Does the policy cover pre-operative diagnostic tests if the surgery is performed under a different insurance plan?",
    "Is an Andrology consultation for fertility issues considered a valid medical expense for the birth of a twin?",
    "How much of the total bill can be claimed for a minor dental cleaning if it was done during a hospitalization for fever?",
    "Will the insurer cover the cost of a wheelchair if it was bought as a medical aid after a stroke?",
    "Can I split the claim for a single-day procedure between this policy and another one I own?",
    "Is the cost of a scribe or medical attendant during hospital stay included in the room rent reimbursement?",
    "Does the policy pay for emergency detoxification services if the admission is not for a covered illness?",
    "Can I claim the cost of a physiotherapy session if the doctor advised it after discharge?",
    "Will the insurer reimburse the rental cost of an oxygen concentrator used at home for six weeks?",
    "Is the cost of a cosmetic procedure to remove scar tissue covered if deemed medically necessary by the doctor?",
    "Can I claim for the cost of a diagnostic MRI if the primary insurance denies coverage due to age limits?",
    "Does the policy cover the cost of a prosthetic limb if the amputation resulted from an accident not covered under the current policy?",
    "Will the insurer pay for a second opinion from a specialist if the initial diagnosis seems wrong?",
    "Can I claim the cost of a hearing aid if the doctor prescribes it for age-related hearing loss?",
    "Is the cost of a home nurse for post-operative care reimbursable if recommended by the treating surgeon?",
    "Does the policy cover the cost of a rehabilitation camp for mental health issues if not admitted to a hospital?",
    "Can I claim for the cost of a medical check-up package if it includes screening for a cancer I later get diagnosed with?",
    "Will the insurer reimburse the cost of a splint or brace if bought from a third-party pharmacy instead of the hospital?"
  ]
}
